title: I see you!
author: Lisa Patnaik
text:
Yesterday you came to me
Asking me to leave everything
And walk with you
Just like before.

You smiled at me
Warm , kind & full of love
And you signalled to hang over you,
Just like before.

I was happy
Yet became happier
To see you right there in my universe
Just like before.

As if I knew
That you would come
To take me home
Just like you had said before;
In my dreams
Had lost all hopes
And all paths leading to you
Just like I never thought before.

And here you were
To take me along
The memories of life
That we created together;
Drenching in air
Soaking in morning sun
Filled with pure joy
Just like how we had thought, before.

Oh , did I tell you
That all of this
And everything I said
Was just a dream?
Yet I`m happy
You came along
With your purple love
And the passionate smile.

Now don`t laugh at me
When you read this,
Let me be in love with moments
That I most cherish -
A selfish lover , being me!
